description: This file defines a utility class 'Precision' for comparing floating-point numbers, including methods for equality checks with error tolerances, rounding, and handling special cases like NaN and infinity. It provides constants for machine epsilon and safe minimum in IEEE 754 double precision floating-point arithmetic.

classes.name: Precision
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to compare floating-point numbers with various error tolerances, handle special values like NaN and infinity, and perform rounding operations, tailored for IEEE 754 double precision arithmetic.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two doubles considering an absolute epsilon, returning 0 if equal within epsilon, -1 if less, 1 if greater.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two doubles considering a maximum number of ULPs (units in the last place).
